_meta.experiment: exp-032, the wider degraded corpus re-pin
_meta.why: the exp-030 magnitudes were measured on ten files of a tier with large between-file variance, so the paired CIs straddled zero even where the replicate z did not. This regenerates the family at n=30 on fresh seeds and asks which of those magnitudes survive.

corpus.hard_family: simulation/gen_scenarios.py --hard --train 0 --val 0 --test 30 --seed 32032, once per attribution variant. The generator stamps the attribution section and makes no rng draw, so all five variants pair byte for byte, verified 30/30.
corpus.mainnet: gen_mainnet.py, payment seeds 2001..2030, sealed exp-009 tier shape (hub vantage, 10 payments, amounts {100M,500M,1000M,2000M}, max_parts 8) with the sealed tier's own target-degree distribution mirrored

arms.ilnd: interval-sim@dcde83cca, carrying the committed V3 fix
arms.prefix: the round-6 branch tip BEFORE the V3 fix, mix tier only, to re-pin the original bug's magnitude
arms.round2: the interval router before rounds 3-6, the reference the exp-030 give-back was measured against

caveat_not_the_sealed_tier.statement: this hard family is NOT the sealed hard tier and its absolute numbers are not comparable to it. The sealed hard-test files came from an uncommitted working copy of the generator and exp-020 established they are not reproducible from any committed revision. A fresh --hard corpus at a new seed is a harder world: stock lnd scores 0.136 here against 0.309 on the sealed tier, and the interval router 0.366 against 0.572.
caveat_not_the_sealed_tier.consequence: only CONTRASTS transfer between the two, never levels. Every claim below is a contrast measured within this corpus.

Q1_do_the_margins_hold_on_fresh_files.answer: YES on six of seven tiers, all CI-solid at n=30 and by margins far larger than anything the sealed tiers showed. NO on degraded mainnet, and the reason is instructive rather than damaging.
Q1_do_the_margins_hold_on_fresh_files.the_mn_mix_exception: on degraded mainnet ilnd beats lnd by 0.0022, p=0.86. Read the columns separately, which is this program's rule, and the reason is lnd's objective RISING under degradation: +0.0633 against its own clean control, while its success FALLS 0.543 to 0.530 and its give-ups climb 0.397 to 0.470. Its attempts collapse from 15.4 to 2.4. The composite is paying lnd for abandoning, which is the exp-013 give-up attractor and the exp-019 shift anomaly showing up together. ilnd's own success on that tier, 0.530, is identical to lnd's; mx_c3 holds 0.557.
Q1_do_the_margins_hold_on_fresh_files.on_the_hard_family_lnd_collapses_the_sam: unknown 0.2 takes lnd's success from 0.298 to 0.138 and its attempts from 61 to 3.0. The interval router goes 0.537 to 0.540. That is exp-019's headline reproduced at n=30 on files nobody has seen before, and it is the strongest form the claim has ever been in.

Q2_the_exp030_magnitudes_repinned.answer: They do NOT re-pin. The mechanism is real; the objective cost measured on the sealed tier is not a property of the hard family.

the_bug.reading: the pre-fix tip costs 0.0099 against the round-2 reference here, not 0.0341, and the CI straddles zero with the signs split 10/10.

the_fix.reading: the fix recovers 0.0034 here against 0.0439 there, and is indistinguishable from zero.

give_back_on_unknown_only.answer: STAYS INSIGNIFICANT, which was the question. unknown 0.2 is +0.0038 and unknown 0.3 is -0.0031, both CIs straddling zero. The fix costs nothing measurable on the tiers it was feared to.

the_one_CI_solid_effect.reading: rounds 3-6 net out at -0.0015 on the CLEAN control, CI excluding zero on 7 differing files out of 30. It is 0.15% of objective and every other classic-tier check in rounds 4-6 found the clean tiers byte-identical, so this is a real but negligible drift introduced somewhere in rounds 3-6, worth recording and not worth acting on.

Q2_the_exp030_magnitudes_repinned.how_to_read_this: exp-030's mechanism findings stand on evidence that is not the objective delta: the ablation (removing the quarantine recovered what the tip lost, on the same files) and the ground-truth counters (67 hard bounds on channels that never failed under the mix, 0 under unknown-only). Those were measured directly and are not in question. What exp-032 kills is the MAGNITUDE claim: 0.034 of objective was a property of ten sealed files, not of the hard family, and the PR should quote the mechanism and the counters rather than the number.

Q3_the_deg_mainnet_gap_vs_mx_c3.answer: HALVED AND NO LONGER CI-SOLID, but still the largest deficit in the sweep and still in the same direction.
Q3_the_deg_mainnet_gap_vs_mx_c3.success_side: mx_c3 is the only arm whose success does not move at all under degraded mainnet, 0.557 to 0.557. lnd loses 0.013 and ilnd 0.033. That is the same shape round 3 reported and it survives the wider corpus even though the objective delta no longer clears its CI.
Q3_the_deg_mainnet_gap_vs_mx_c3.reading: the champions still hold something on degraded mainnet that the port does not. It is the one open deficit going into replay week.

verdict.cap_sensitivity: every ilnd lead over lnd survives uncapping. On the unknown tiers it shrinks as the cap lifts (hard_unk20 +0.261 capped to +0.221 uncapped) because lnd's collapse there is partly an attempt collapse the cap was hiding; on the clean tiers it GROWS (hard_clean +0.230 to +0.680). Nothing here is an artifact of the attempt subsidy.
verdict.headline: On thirty fresh files per tier the integrated router's margin over stock lnd is larger and better-supported than anything the sealed tiers ever showed: +0.164 to +0.261 across the hard family and +0.096 on mainnet, every one CI-solid, driven by lnd abandoning payments under unreadable failures while the interval router holds success flat. Two exp-030 numbers do not survive the widening: the deg_hard_mix bug and its fix are both indistinguishable from zero here, so the mechanism should be quoted from the ablation and the counters rather than from 0.034. The degraded-mainnet deficit against mx_c3 halves to -0.021 and loses significance, but mx_c3 remains the only arm that holds success exactly there.
